findings.description: Explainer on the seismically unsafe Hall of Justice at 850 Bryant: officials weighing demolition or relocating court operations, with a supervisor proposing a hearing on Mid-Market sites (1455 Market, 50 UN Plaza). Assembled from Chronicle, ABC7 and Standard reporting.

citation.label: Hoodline, “SF's Crumbling Hall of Justice Faces Demolition After 34 Years of Warnings,” 18 November 2026

raw.text: city officials are finally weighing whether to tear it down or relocate the court operations still inside it

publish.note: No dated event at the building: nothing was decided, filed or voted on, and the piece is a roundup that relays the Chronicle, ABC7 and the Standard rather than reporting of its own. A demolition vote, a relocation decision or a funded replacement would earn an entry. 1455 Market, 50 UN Plaza, 425 Seventh St. and 822 Geary are passing mentions as candidate sites or background.
